PullRequest.Title: sessions: restore Agent Merge background fixture rendering
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary
Fix the `sessions/chat/view/chatView/AgentMergeBackground` screenshot regression following #335254.

The fixture directly creates chat model requests, bypassing provider metadata mapping and history restoration. It supplied `isSystemInitiated` but omitted the newly required `requestSource: 'agentMerge'`, so the renderer correctly treated it as an ordinary system request and displayed the raw prompt. Production Agent Host paths already provide this source.

- Supply the explicit request source in the background fixture, matching the other Agent Merge fixtures.
- Add a rendering assertion so the fixture fails if the Agent Merge card is missing rather than silently accepting a raw-prompt screenshot.
- No production rendering or compatibility behavior changes.

## Validation
- `npm run transpile-client` passed.
- Focused `getChatRequestText` unit test passed.
- Hygiene for the changed fixture and `git diff --check` passed.
- Browser checks confirmed one Agent Merge card and the `1 Failing Check, Agent Merge` accessible label in Light and Dark variants. Local Vite validation needed temporary JSONC-theme handling; cold fixture loads also reported the local explorer's 3-second timeout. Temporary validation configuration was removed.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render the AgentMergeBackground browser screenshot fixture across themed variants
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The fixture builds three in-memory chat messages, awaits `renderChatView`/`renderChatWidget` to populate and lay out the list, then performs one synchronous `querySelector` assertion before the fixture can complete. The changed `requestSource` selects the existing Agent Merge card renderer during that awaited render.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fixed fixture data: three requests, one Agent Merge prompt with zero review comments and one failed check. The prompt parse scales with this fixed prompt length; card DOM creation scales with the fixed summary contents; the assertion scans the bounded fixture DOM once.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Message insertion and widget rendering are synchronous/sequential within the awaited fixture render. The assertion runs once after rendering; no fan-out, queue, background task, or unbounded parallelism is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache or persisted state participates in the changed path. Cold and repeated fixture runs each reconstruct the same bounded in-memory model and DOM; the diff neither adds cache misses nor changes cache keys/coalescing.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed metadata is passed directly to `ChatModel.addRequest`, `renderSystemInitiatedRequest` checks it and constructs `ChatAgentMergeContentPart`, and the added assertion is visibly one post-render DOM query. Inspection found only in-memory parsing, allocation, DOM rendering/layout, and no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, or network operation on this path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact fixture render-time difference between the prior generic system-notification rendering and the Agent Merge card is unmeasured, but it is bounded to one small synthetic card and one DOM query and cannot affect production runtime.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff intentionally changes only a screenshot fixture from the generic raw-prompt/system-notification path to the existing Agent Merge card path and adds a single bounded assertion. Production code and user workflows are unchanged; any extra fixture-only DOM work has fixed cardinality and negligible bounded impact.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the sole changed fixture hunk and its model, renderer, parser, DOM, and assertion call paths. No diff-introduced production performance regression, scaling boundary fan-out, retention, repeated hot-path work, or reportable fixture slowdown was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
